race.title: Ladbrokes 'Get Your Free Racing Bet Today' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: FEVER DREAM and Gasmani appeal most, with Christian Williams' charge fancied to make it 3 wins from his last 5 starts over fences. Muskoka and Ideal Des Bordes both come with risks attached, so likely improver Draco Malfoy gets the nod as best of the rest. FEVER DREAM (IRE) GASMANI (IRE) DRACO MALFOY (IRE)
